```{r}
background <- read_csv('/Users/nicholaschan/Desktop/PSTAT197A/module0-class-survey-team7/data/background-clean.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
interest <- read_csv('/Users/nicholaschan/Desktop/PSTAT197A/module0-class-survey-team7/data/interest-clean.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_csv('/Users/nicholaschan/Desktop/PSTAT197A/module0-class-survey-team7/data/survey-metadata.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)


mandatory <- c("PSTAT 120", "CS 9", "PSTAT 122", "PSTAT 126")

joint <- background %>%
  inner_join(interest, by = "response_id") %>%
  mutate(
     num_areas = str_count(areas, ",") + 1L,
    non_mandatory_courses = courses %>%
      str_split(",\\s*") %>%
      map_chr(~ toString(setdiff(.x[.x != ""], mandatory))),
      num_non_mandatory = str_count(non_mandatory_courses, ",") + 1L)

joint
```




```{r}

combined <- interest %>% inner_join(background, by = "response_id")

combined <- combined[c("courses", "areas")]

combined
mandatory <- c("PSTAT 120", "CS 9", "PSTAT 122", "PSTAT 126", "CS 16")

data <- combined %>% 
  
  # separates the string containing the list of courses into each course code
  # counts number of courses taken that were not in our list of mandatory courses
  mutate(non_mandatory = sum(!(strsplit(courses, 
                                split = ", ")[[1]] %in% mandatory)), 
                                .by = "courses") %>%
  
  # separates the string containing the list of areas of interest by the commas
  # counts the number of areas of interest
  # some areas of interest have ", generally" attached to the end
  # accidentally counts generally as an area since it comes after comma
  # counts the number of "generally" and subtracts from the original count
  mutate(num_areas = length(
    strsplit(areas[[1]], split = ", ")[[1]]) - 
      sum(strsplit(areas[[1]], split = ", ")[[1]] == "generally"), 
    .by = areas) %>%
  
  # only keeps the counts of non-mandatory courses and areas of interest
  select(non_mandatory, num_areas)

head(data)
```



```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = non_mandatory)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Number of Non-Mandatory Courses", y = "Number of People") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 13, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 2))

ggplot(joint, aes(x = num_areas)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Number of Areas of Interest", y = "Number of People Interested in X Areas") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 13, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 2))
```

```{r}
# bar plot of Number of Areas of interest

  geom_bar(fill = "#003660", col = "#FEBC11") +
  labs(x = "Number of Areas of Interest", y = "Number of People Interested in X Areas") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 13, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 2))

ggplot(data, aes(x = num_areas, y = non_mandatory)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")


```

```{r}
lr <- lm(num_areas ~ non_mandatory, data = data)
summary(lr)
plot(lr)
plot(lr, which = 1)
shapiro.test(lr$residuals)
mean(lr$residuals)


qqnorm(lr$residuals, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(lr$residuals, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
```
